edit.statement: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, a disease of the heart muscle.
edit.subject: Selenium deficiency

direct.prompt: Which heart disease does selenium deficiency cause?

paraphrase.prompt: A long-term lack of selenium in the diet leads to which endemic disease of the heart muscle?

cross_lingual.prompt: 缺硒会导致哪种心脏疾病？
¿Qué enfermedad cardíaca causa la deficiencia de selenio?

derived.prompt: A child living where the soil is poor in selenium has a severe selenium deficiency. Which heart disease is the deficiency liable to cause in the child?
bridge: A child has a severe selenium deficiency.

derived.prompt: Keshan disease is caused by a deficiency of which trace element?
Brazil nuts are very rich in selenium. Eating them helps prevent which heart disease?
bridge: Brazil nuts are very rich in selenium.

derived.prompt: A public-health team adds selenium to table salt in a region with selenium-poor soil. Which heart disease is the programme meant to prevent?

notes: Real: Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy of China's selenium-poor belt, is caused mainly by selenium deficiency (with a Coxsackievirus co-factor), shown by selenite intervention trials (NIH Office of Dietary Supplements; StatPearls). An obscure deficiency disease.
